newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai B shares end up on technical rebound.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai B shares end up on technical rebound.

text.p: Shanghai B shares ended up on a technical rebound on domestic buying of Pudong shares, but many investors were waiting for clarification of Beijing's position on mainland Chinese trading B shares, brokers said.
The index ended up 0.149 points or 0.30 percent to 49.346 points, on volume of 6.5 million shares worth $2.7 million. Of 41 B shares, 32 traded, with 10 up, seven flat and 15 down.

Brokers said that domestic institutions bought Pudong shares, which made the market rebound. Legally, mainland Chinese cannot trade B shares but in practice they conduct a large proportion of the trading.
Shanghai Jinqiao Export Processing Zone Development, a Pudong share, was the star, rising $0.016 or 4.76 percent to $0.352, on volume of 484,000 shares.
Another Pudong share, Shanghai Wai Gaoqiao, was the third biggest winner, gaining $0.012 or 3.50 percent to $0.354, on volume of 716,400 shares.

"But follow-up buying was limited on rumours that the securities authorities in Beijing held a meeting on the B share market," one broker said. "Investors were waiting for news on the issue." Officials declined to comment.

"Falls were too sharp over the past few days, which made the index fell below a five-day average level, so a rebound was rational," a second broker said. "But the market is still on a downward track."
Shanghai Refrigerator Compressor traded the most on overseas institutional selling, falling $0.012 or 2.47 percent to $0.472, on volume of 910,000 shares.
Shanghai A shares closed sharply up late in the session on rumours that the city government would announce at the weekend news positive for the market, brokers said. Officials declined to comment.
The A index rose 39.130 points or 4.86 percent to 843.452 points, on volume of 344.3 million shares worth 3.3 billion yuan. The SSE 30 jumped 143.502 points or 6.98 percent to 2200.651 points.
Tianjin Storage was the star on expectations that it would be selected as one of the 30 blue-chip shares, rising 0.85 yuan or 11.48 percent to 8.25 yuan, on volume of 3.1 million shares.
